name: Phone
title: Phone: this Rouh's own address on the relay, locked end to end, opened from the chat

permissions: asks the relay's claim endpoint for this Rouh's address at birth, signed with its daily key, only when it was born Connected
runs frp's client, which keeps one line open to the relay while the owner has the address on
gets and renews a Let's Encrypt certificate for its own address
touches.remove: the Settings section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, phonepage.js/.css, rouh/relay.py, rouh/acme.py, rouh/web/relay.py and its routes, the relay lines in rouh/web/gate.py, rouh/web/auth.py, rouh/web/firstrun.py and rouh/runtime.py, phone_in.html, frpc in deploy/container/Dockerfile.base and this manifest; delete the data folder's relay/.
